Interface LiveReloadServer

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable, Closeable
public interface LiveReloadServer extends Closeable
A running LiveReload server: browsers connected to it reload the page, or swap a stylesheet, on request. The implementation comes from a LiveReloadServerFactory on the development runtime classpath, micronaut-dev-livereload; without one there is no server.
Since:
5.3.0
Author:
graemerocher

    • serve

      String serve(String prefix, Path directory)
      Serves the files of a directory under a path prefix, on the loopback address and the port of the server, so a page such as a test report has an http://localhost address rather than a file: one. A request for a directory serves its index.html, and the HTML served carries the client script, so the page reloads when asked. Nothing outside the directory is served. Mounting a prefix again replaces the directory.
      Parameters:
      prefix - The path prefix, such as /reports/tests/
      directory - The directory
      Returns:
      The address of the mount, such as http://localhost:35729/reports/tests/
      Since:
      5.3.0
